title: Search & reporting: full-text, Scout, read replicas

preview.what: Search and reporting at scale: full-text indexes, Scout, read replicas, reporting DBs.
preview.picture: Don't do your accounting on the checkout counter — move heavy reads to a replica or a search engine.
preview.why: Reporting pages that time out are a common take-home scenario.
preview.bn: Checkout counter-এ হিসাব কষো না — ভারী পড়া replica বা search engine-এ সরাও।
